actor.description: Recorded actor identity, not host-authenticated authority.

file.description: A staged file relative to the work directory. The consumer verifies its actual bytes against sha256.

relativePath.description: A slash-separated file path relative to the work directory; no absolute path, dot segment, parent traversal, drive prefix or backslash.

context.description: Supporting notes and reference files used to understand the task, separate from its inputs. Empty collections explicitly mean no extra context. Context does not grant additional execution authority.
context.title: Request context

decision.description: .works/<workId>/decisions/<id>.json: an attributed decision on an exact work revision and subject digest. Identity and authority are not authenticated by this schema.
decision.title: Decision

evidence.description: .works/<workId>/evidence/<id>.json: artifact metadata. Existence, actual digest and evidentiary relevance require separate checks.
evidence.title: Evidence

index.description: Version 1 of the proposed .works document format. A document must match exactly one kind. This contract does not migrate or reinterpret legacy session records.
index.title: Works document contract

inputs.description: The prompts and files the request asks the skill to act on. At least one prompt or file is required.
inputs.title: Request inputs

output.description: One produced output. Text is inline; commits identify a repository and full object ID; images and other files bind persisted artifacts. Output metadata alone does not prove correctness or publication.
output.title: Response output

request.description: .works/<workId>/requests/<id>.json: prompts and files to act on, with supporting context kept separate, against one work revision. This record alone grants no execution permission.
request.title: Request

response.description: .works/<workId>/responses/<id>.json: typed outputs produced for one request. Optional verification observations describe their checks separately; delivering an output is not a claim that the work is proved complete.

feedbackRound.description: Completed feedback-and-repair rounds for this request. Initial candidate is round zero; the caller maintains truthful history.

response.title: Response

work.description: .works/<id>/work.json: goal, declared scope, acceptance criteria and current lifecycle.
work.title: Work

@cli/python.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/python.note: Resolve Python 3 from the active environment: python, python3, or py -3 as appropriate; record the selected executable and any launcher arguments.

@cli/shell.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/shell.note: Resolve to the session shell (PowerShell, bash or another declared shell); do not assume bash on Windows. Arguments remain separate data until encoded for that shell.
@cli/shell.purpose: Run a declared command in the active session shell.

@tools/agent.bind: Resolve the active host delegation capability at invocation time. Require availability, user authorization where applicable, bounded context and declared ownership. Wait for the returned evidence before consuming it.
@tools/agent.purpose: Dispatch bounded work or independent review to a separate agent and receive its result through the active session.

@tools/fileread.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/fileread.purpose: Read declared workspace files and directories through the active session.

claude.via: Claude Code Read, Glob and Grep

@tools/imagegen.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/imagegen.purpose: Produce artwork: a digital image from an image model, made to one stated claim. Rendering HTML is the visualize tool, not this one.

claude.via: none; a judged step records that no artwork could be made and the branch continues; a required step blocks with the operator's own code

openai.via: the OpenAI image model available to the Codex session

@tools/imageview.bind: Image inspection capability advertised by the active session; inspect actual pixels, not filenames or metadata.
@tools/imageview.purpose: Inspect image pixels through session image input or an image viewing tool.

claude.via: Attached images or an image-capable file reader.

openai.via: Attached images or an available image viewing tool.

@tools/sourcewrite.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/sourcewrite.purpose: Edit files within the declared write scope through the active session.

@tools/websearch.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/websearch.purpose: Read public web pages to close one named gap in the evidence; results are references with URLs, never authority.

@workspaces/artifacts.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/artifacts.purpose: Produced files, including images, documents and other deliverables.

@workspaces/context.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/context.purpose: Supporting reference files for a request.

@workspaces/inputs.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/inputs.purpose: Files supplied as the subject of a request.

@workspaces/requests.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/requests.purpose: Requests with separate inputs and context.

@workspaces/responses.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/responses.purpose: Responses declaring produced outputs and execution status.

@workspaces/work.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/work.purpose: One work record and its associated files.

criteria.history: Retain the frozen brief, accepted outputs, execution transcripts and each concise review. A repair changes only the failed edition, track, image or record. Rejected images are deleted as deliverables while their prompt, failure category and short feedback remain.

items.expect: The request is valid and names content.generate.

onFail.instruction: Name the invalid field and request a correction.

items.expect: All declared source and baseline files match their digests.

onFail.instruction: Ask for the missing or changed source; do not infer its contents.

items.expect: The response satisfies the content response contract.

onFail.instruction: Repair response metadata from verified artifacts.

items.expect: The response binds the exact request revision.

onFail.instruction: Correct the request binding without borrowing outputs.
Remove duplicate declarations and retain the verified artifact.

items.expect: Output files are request-scoped and digest-correct.

onFail.instruction: Re-read bytes and repair the file or metadata from facts.

items.expect: Observations bind declared criteria and evidence.
Every produced artifact covers the frozen brief.

onFail.instruction: Name the missing or extra outcome and repair its owning artifact.

items.expect: Content is supported, clear, accessible and internally consistent.

onFail.instruction: Quote the concrete unsupported or unclear passage and repair only that edition.

items.expect: Tracks pass unchanged commands and any image fits the claim and baseline.

onFail.instruction: Report the failed command or visible defect; repair the owning track or discard and regenerate the rejected image.

items.expect: A fresh artifact-only review has no unresolved finding.

onFail.instruction: Apply the review's concrete feedback to the affected artifact and request a fresh reassessment.

items.expect: Required file, command, research and optional image capabilities are available.

onFail.instruction: Return blocked with the exact capability and affected artifact.

items.expect: The brief has enough authoritative content to produce the unit.

onFail.instruction: Ask only for the missing outcome, source, command or visual baseline.

items.expect: Transient calls complete without duplicating outputs.

onFail.instruction: Inspect existing artifacts and command effects, then retry only the incomplete call with a new attempt id.

criteria.stopWhen: Return done only when all machine and review criteria pass and criteriaResults accepts them. Otherwise return a truthful non-done status; stop after two feedback rounds or an unchanged repeated failure.

purpose: Create or revise one educational content unit from a frozen brief, verify its claims and executable tracks, and retain an independent quality review.

request.description: inputs.prompts identify the unit, audience, learning outcomes, languages, optional image intent, executable tracks and exact commands. inputs.files carry source material; context.files carry curriculum or style references. If an existing image is extended or revised, context.visual and its exact baseline image are required.
request.title: content.generate request

response.description: A done response includes the frozen brief, complete content package and independent review. Optional images, prompts, tracks and execution reports are additional typed outputs.
response.title: content.generate response

scope: Content artifacts for one unit and its declared languages and tracks. It may research cited public facts and generate an optional image. It does not change curriculum authority, publish served content, or claim learner outcomes.

calls.purpose: Read declared source and context files.
Close one named public-source gap without replacing supplied authority.
calls.when: when a factual gap requires current public evidence

calls.purpose: Persist the brief before any edition is written.

steps.instruction: Read the request, source material and curriculum context. Freeze audience, outcomes, required languages, claims, citations, optional image intent, tracks and unchanged commands before producing an edition. Ask for any fact essential to correctness.

reads.when: when curriculum or style context is declared

calls.purpose: Write editions, tracks, prompt and package manifest inside the request artifact scope.
Generate or revise the requested educational image using the actual bound reference image.
calls.when: only when the frozen brief requires an image

steps.instruction: Create every declared language edition from the frozen brief. Create each requested executable track without changing its contract. If an image is requested, generate only the brief's visual claim. For extend or revise, pass the actual selected baseline plus all preserve/change instructions; never substitute unrelated art or conversation memory.
produces: Declared editions, tracks and optional image assets.

reads.when: when context.visual mode is extend or revise

writes.when: for each edition, track, prompt or accepted image

calls.purpose: Run only the build and check commands frozen in the brief.
Inspect actual accepted candidate pixels beside the baseline when applicable.
Persist execution evidence and targeted artifact repairs; remove rejected image deliverables.

steps.instruction: Run each declared build and executable check unchanged and record raw command, exit code and output. Inspect actual image pixels when present. Give concrete defects, delete rejected image deliverables, retain concise rejection metadata, and repair only the affected artifact before rerunning dependent checks.
produces: Execution evidence and assessed content artifacts.

calls.purpose: Give a separate reviewer only the frozen brief and produced artifacts, withholding the producer rationale.
Read the returned independent review and referenced artifacts.
Persist review evidence and response metadata.
Validate the compiled operator request and response.

steps.instruction: Dispatch a fresh artifact-only review without the producer rationale. Persist findings and reassess after targeted repair. Write and validate the response only when the independent review and all criteria accept the artifacts.

writes.when: after acceptance or a terminal stop

validate.failurePolicy: Freeze the brief before production. For each failed criterion, retain concise feedback, repair only the owning edition, track, image or record, then reassess. Discard rejected image files while retaining failure metadata and accepted outputs.

review.instruction: Check every requested language and artifact against the frozen brief. Every learning outcome, source constraint and requested track must be covered without adding a new curriculum claim.
Review factual support, attribution, learner clarity, examples, accessibility and internal consistency. Identify concrete unsupported or misleading statements.

Inspect each executable track using its unchanged build and check transcript. When images are present, inspect actual pixels against the brief and the supplied baseline; reject unrelated art or unverified visual inheritance.
Require a review based on the artifacts without the producer's rationale. Every applicable finding must be resolved and reassessed before acceptance.
